meanings.en: to disrupt, to ruin (a lesson or plan)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'орвать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to ruin / disrupt', paired with 'срывать'.

examples.trans: We must ruin this wedding.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'адиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'sit down', paired with 'сесть'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'везти'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'I will give a ride'.

not to I will give a ride (negated infinitive)
